recommendation: Implement comprehensive care coordination and navigation for diabetes patients
implementation_steps: Oversee care transitions and facilitate communication among providers
Track completion of recommended screenings (e.g., A1C, eye exams)
Help patients navigate the health system
Screen for and address barriers to self-management
evidence_summary: Care coordination interventions have been shown to improve diabetes outcomes, including glycemic control, screening completion rates, and reduced hospitalizations, particularly for patients with complex care needs.
citation: Improving Care and Promoting Health in Populations: Standards of Care in Diabetes-2025
